data_objects.name: daily_market_bars
data_objects.meaning: Daily open-high-low-close market bars with trading volume for an unspecified traded instrument.
data_objects.notes: The instrument, venue, price currency, and volume unit are not named in train.csv.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Calendar date of the market interval, encoded as YYYY-MM-DD.

variables.name: Volume
variables.meaning: Trading volume recorded for the date.

structure.description: Each row represents one daily market interval keyed and chronologically ordered by Date.
Open, High, Low, and Close form the price summary for the date; Volume records activity for the same interval.

uncertainties: The traded instrument, currency, venue, time zone, and corporate-action treatment are not supplied.
The unit and inclusion rules for Volume are unspecified.
annotation_notes: The map retains generic daily-market semantics because train.csv does not identify the asset.
